services.name: Molokini and Turtle Town Snorkel Adventure  Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Join us for an Epic Molokini Crater Snorkeling Adventure! A Molokini snorkeling adventure aboard Calypso is the most fun on Maui! This stable, high-speed, triple-decker catamaran will get you to two snorkel sites fast: Molokini Crater and Turtle Town, and with all the equipment you need and plenty of food on board, what more could you ask for? You’ll be welcomed aboard by our friendly crew and enjoy a delicious, hearty breakfast. After everyone is settled in, it’s off to the most popular underwater destination in Maui for some morning Molokini snorkeling! While you’re enjoying the feel of the ocean wind in your hair, from December through April, watch the horizon for the incredible humpback

services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor:  Whale Watch Cruise Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Experience the awe-inspiring behaviors of the Humpback whales on this incredible whale watching adventure Come aboard the Calypso a power catamaran with three decks each providing excellent vantage points for viewing the Humpback whales. Whether you are seated outside on the upper decks or inside the shaded cabin all feel like front row seats. Our Captain will provide an expert narrative of the Humpback whale's historical significance in Maui waters and "play-by-play" commentary of the incredible whale behaviors as you view them. services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: Sunset Prime Rib or Fresh Island Fish Dinner Cruise
services.desc: An unforgettable Maui dining experience you do not want to miss Socialize with family and friends, sip on cocktails, and take in the world-famous Maui sunset as our attentive crew serves you a delicious three-course meal table-side. This spacious triple-deck catamaran offers comfortable seating with generous table spacing for a more private intimate setting. Whether you are seated outside on the upper decks or inside the shaded cabin below all provide excellent vantage points to enjoy the beautiful Maui scenery. Every table feels like a front row seat which is exactly what you want when we come across a pod of dolphin or Humpback whales (whale sightings are seasonal December – April). Add

services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: Thanksgiving Dinner Cruise Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Give thanks Hawaiian style on this special holiday dinner cruise aboard the Calypso. Relax with family and friends, listen to music, and enjoy the spectacular views of the West Maui Mountains and neighboring islands on Molokai and Lanai as we cruise the calm Maui waters. Sip on cocktails, beer, and wine as our crew serves you table-side a Hawaiian-influenced Thanksgiving day feast with all the fixings. The Calypso is a triple-decker power catamaran with a spacious deck and plenty of comfortable table and chair seating for everyone. services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: July 4th Fireworks and Cocktail Cruise Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: From Ma'alaea Harbor: July 4Th Fireworks and Cocktail Cruise Aboard the Calypso Celebrate our independence and watch the fireworks from the ocean with the best seat in the house aboard the Calypso. Avoid the traffic and the crowds and leave the car at home. Instead cruise with us on the Calypso where you can watch the spectacular 4th of July fireworks show. Sit back, relax, listen to good music, and enjoy delicious Pupu’s with an ice-cold beer, glass of wine, or cocktail. Watch the fireworks show in comfort and style with unbeatable views. Great for the whole family, honeymooners, and those looking for a special seat to enjoy our freedom! SEATING IS ON FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS Mandatory
